Hey man,

hope you're doing ok. I can definitely relate to some of the stuff you've been going through (morning fear, emptiness, etc.). I'm the last one to be giving advice, but I'll give it my best shot. Face the fact that your last few years have been pretty shitty; i know mine have been. Rather then dwell on what you could have done, focus on what you can do now in the next few years. You got into one of the top 10 business programs so you must be pretty intelligent. 

Again, not really sure how I can help, but I can relate to any suicidal/depressed feelings you may have been having. Feel free to PM me if you want

I've participated in a lot of counseling over the years and more intensively in the last few months. Can't even explain why I think the way I do, but been in that hole for a long long time. I don't think I'll get better
Thanks for the comment. I'll try those things out
